results.content: The Director-General of the Ghana Prisons Service, Patience Baffoe-Bonnie, has described the conditions under which some prison officers work as “hell”, appealing for welfare interventions, including a contagious disease allowance, to improve their working conditions and protect their well-being.

results.content: The Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) is set to commence a nationwide meter audit exercise across all its operational areas to reduce commercial losses, improve revenue assurance and combat electricity theft.

results.title: GES directs Ashanti Regional and Obuasi Municipal education directors to step aside over Obuasi SHTS probe
results.content: The Ghana Education Service (GES) has directed the Ashanti Regional Director of Education, Dr William Amankrah Appiah, and the Obuasi Municipal Director of Education, Kwamena Owusu-Nketiah, to step aside with immediate effect as investigations continue into allegations of sexual misconduct involving the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), Zakaria Abdulai. In a statement issued on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, and signed by its Head of Public Relations, Daniel Fenyi, the GES said the directive was intended to ensure the investigation proceeds without interference or the perception of interference. The two directors have been instructed to hand over their offices and all state property in their possession to the Deputy Ashanti Regional Director of Education, Thomas Kwame Boateng.

results.title: GoldBod targets bigger stake for Ghana in new mines through geological studies
results.content: The Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) is undertaking geological investigations in parts of the country to reduce investment risks and position Ghana to secure stronger equity stakes in future mining projects, Chief Executive Officer Sammy Gyamfi has announced.

results.title: GoldBod reforms recover gold worth $11.4bn previously lost through trade leakages – Sammy Gyamfi
results.content: The Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), Sammy Gyamfi, has highlighted the scale of gold trade leakages Ghana faced before the introduction of reforms to formalise the artisanal and small-scale mining sector.

results.title: GoldBod to introduce blockchain tracking system to fight illegal gold trade
results.content: The Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) is procuring a blockchain-based tracking system to improve gold traceability, strengthen responsible sourcing and curb illegal trading and smuggling.

results.title: Lack of family support, limited job opportunities driving ex-convicts back to prison – Prisons Service
results.content: The Director-General of the Ghana Prisons Service, Patience Baffoe-Bonnie, has identified family neglect, social exclusion and limited employment opportunities as key factors contributing to the return of former inmates to prison.

results.title: Marine Police search for missing canoe and seven crew members off Western coast
results.content: The Western Regional Marine Police Command is coordinating a multi-agency search for a missing fishing canoe, Second Chance, and its seven crew members after the vessel failed to return from a fishing expedition off Axim. The search involves the Ghana Navy, Ghana Maritime Authority (GMA), Fisheries Commission and fishing communities along the coast. In a statement issued on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, and signed by Chief Superintendent of Police Olivia Et Adiku, Head of the Public Affairs Unit of the Western Region, the Police said the canoe’s owner, Nana Kweku Atta, reported the disappearance at the Fishing Harbour Police Station in Sekondi on October 18.

results.title: Obuasi SHTS headmaster resigns as NDC constituency secretary, withdraws from chairmanship race
results.content: The headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), Zakaria Abdulai, has resigned as Juaben Constituency Secretary of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) and withdrawn his candidature for the constituency chairmanship, amid allegations of sexual abuse involving female students at the school.

results.title: ASWAJ SHS: Bono East’s first Islamic SHS faces furniture & accommodation challenges—MP pledges 200 desks
results.content: When the ASWAJ Islamic Senior High School opened its doors in 2024, it made history as the first and only public Senior High School in the Bono East Region. With an initial enrollment of just 50 students, it was a humble beginning for what has quickly become a beacon of hope for the community.

results.title: NDC directs accused Obuasi SHTS headmaster to step aside from Juaben chairmanship race
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) has directed Zakaria Abdulai, the suspended headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), to step aside from the Juaben Constituency Chairmanship race pending an investigation by the Criminal Investigations Department (CID) of the Ghana Police Service. In a statement issued on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, and signed by General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey, the party said its Functional Executive Committee (FEC) took the decision after further consideration. “FEC has directed that Mr Zakaria Abdulai step aside, in the overriding interest of transparency and accountability, to allow for an unhindered investigation by the Criminal Investigations Department (CID) of the Ghana Police Service,” the statement said.

results.title: GoldBod to launch financing support programme for small-scale miners in 2027 – Sammy Gyamfi
results.content: The Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) will introduce an Artisanal and Small-scale Mining Formalisation and Financing Support Programme in 2027 to improve productivity, create jobs and reduce the environmental impact of mining.

results.title: Ghana Publishing Company warns fake gazette publishers of arrest, prosecution
results.content: The Ghana Publishing Company Limited (GPC) has warned individuals producing fake versions of Ghana’s laws and manipulating gazetted documents that they risk arrest and prosecution. The warning comes as the company introduces digital platforms to improve access to its publications and enable the public to verify the authenticity of official documents. Managing Director of GPC, Dan Kwaku Sibuahite, said some individuals had exploited the company’s limited physical presence across the country to circulate unauthorised versions of Ghana’s laws.

results.title: GoldBod reforms create 4,866 direct jobs in less than two years – Sammy Gyamfi
results.content: The Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) says its institutional, licensing and value addition reforms have created 4,866 direct jobs in less than two years, as Ghana seeks to expand local participation in the gold industry.

results.title: CCC to honour teachers as part of its October Commission, offers free medical screening to hundreds
results.content: The Calvary Charismatic Centre (CCC) has announced plans to honour teachers in the Ashanti region for their immense and selfless contribution to education and national development.

results.title: Nii the Menace completes 240km run from Accra to Kumasi to promote breast cancer awareness
results.content: For seven days, Caleb Nii Okai pushed through pain, exhaustion and challenging weather to complete a 240-kilometre run from Accra to Kumasi, carrying a message about breast cancer awareness and the importance of early screening. Popularly known as Nii the Menace, the endurance athlete undertook the challenge to encourage women to pay attention to their breast health and seek medical advice when necessary. Starting from the Balme Library at the University of Ghana, Legon, he made his way towards the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) in Kumasi.

results.title: Christian Council urges gov’t to deploy more military, police to fight galamsey
results.content: The Christian Council of Ghana (CCG) has called on the government to strengthen enforcement of laws against illegal mining, known as galamsey, and deploy more security personnel and resources to protect water bodies and farmlands.

results.title: GoldBod targets zero raw gold exports by 2030 as local refining expands
results.content: The Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) is working towards ending Ghana’s export of raw minerals by 2030, as part of efforts to retain more value from the country’s gold resources through local refining and processing.

results.title: GoldBod exports 85.4 tonnes of small-scale gold worth $11.6bn in 2026 – Sammy Gyamfi
results.content: The Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) has aggregated and exported 85.4 tonnes of artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) gold valued at US$11.6 billion between January 1 and October 20, 2026, Chief Executive Officer Sammy Gyamfi has announced.

results.title: Ato Forson calls for shift in economic policies to secure Ghana’s future
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has urged Ghana to move beyond economic stabilisation and pursue policies that address the underlying challenges facing the economy and support long-term growth.

results.title: Dagbon Regent pledges to sustain late father’s peace and reconciliation efforts
results.content: The Regent of Dagbon, Kampakuya-Naa Yakubu II, has pledged not to compromise the peace and reconciliation process initiated by his late father, Ya-Naa Abukari, assuring that he will strengthen the process to safeguard peace in the kingdom.

results.title: NAIMOS steps up anti-galamsey operations in Wassa Amenfi as chiefs pledge support
results.content: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) has announced plans to deploy more military personnel to the Western Region as it seeks stronger collaboration with traditional authorities and local government officials to combat illegal mining. The Director of Operations at NAIMOS, Colonel K. S. Appiah, disclosed this during separate engagements with the Omanhene of the Wassa Amenfi Traditional Area, Tetrete Okuamoah Sekyim II, and the Municipal Chief Executive (MCE) for Wassa Amenfi, Raymond Nana Ebbah. The visits formed part of the Secretariat’s stakeholder engagement strategy to strengthen local support for anti-galamsey operations.

results.title: Ghana, Burkina Faso explore stronger energy cooperation as SONABHY CEO visits Jinapor
results.content: Ghana and Burkina Faso are exploring ways to deepen cooperation in petroleum transportation and supply following a meeting between the Minister for Energy and Green Transition, Dr John Abdulai Jinapor, and a delegation from Burkina Faso’s national petroleum company, SONABHY.

results.title: Mahama reaffirms commitment to closing northern infrastructure deficit
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has reaffirmed his commitment to addressing the infrastructure deficit in northern Ghana, describing peace and reliable public infrastructure as the two key drivers of private investment and sustainable job creation for the region’s youth.

results.title: SSNIT takes pension services to the doorstep of Ghanaians with 2026 Mobile Service Week in Techiman
results.content: The Social Security and National Insurance Trust (SSNIT) has launched its 2026 Mobile Service Week (MSW) in Techiman, the Bono East Regional capital, with a renewed commitment to bringing pension services closer to members and the general public.

results.title: National Apprenticeship Programme pledges business support for Ask Media Training School graduates
results.content: The National Apprenticeship Programme has pledged to support graduates of Ask Media Training School with tools to establish their own businesses, urging them to turn their practical skills into sustainable livelihoods.

results.content: The latest ranking shows Ghana dropping to 65th place globally from their previous 60th position.

results.title: Energy Ministry woos investors as PHDC signs Global Sphere deal for Petroleum Hub Phase Two
results.content: The Minister of Energy and Green Transition, Dr John Jinapor, has reaffirmed government’s commitment to creating a credible, competitive and investor-friendly energy sector to attract investment and support sustainable growth.

results.title: Kome Shime Traditional Council inducts six new chiefs and queen mothers in Whuti
results.content: The Kome Shime Traditional Council has inducted six new members following a swearing-in ceremony held at Whuti in the Volta Region on Wednesday, October 14, 2026. The ceremony formally welcomed the traditional leaders into the Council, with officials saying the move would strengthen its representation and support traditional governance within the Kome Shime Traditional Area and Anlo State. The newly inducted members are Togbi Agbelom Agbotokor Dzreke II, Divisional Chief of Salo-Sokutsime; Togbi Tsikata Agbodzie II, Divisional Chief of Srogboe; and Mama Amedzor II, Divisional Queenmother of Salo-Sokutsime. The others are Togbi Lagah Doe Dzata V, Sub-Divisional Chief of Whuti; Mama Agume Dzonu II, Sub-Divisional Queenmother of Whuti; and Mama Kordeku II, Sub-Divisional Queenmother of Srogboe.

results.title: Mahama links rising foreign investment to improving economic stability
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama says improving economic stability is strengthening investor confidence in Ghana, with foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows rising to US$2.62 billion in 2025 from US$624 million in 2024.

results.title: Energy Minister pledges inter-ministerial push to unblock Petroleum Hub project
results.content: The Minister for Energy and Green Transition, Dr John Abdulai Jinapor, has pledged to lead inter-ministerial engagements to resolve outstanding land acquisition, compensation and financing issues delaying the development of Ghana’s Petroleum Hub.

results.title: Ghana now facilitates 40% of Burkina Faso’s petroleum transit – Jinapor
results.content: Ghana is facilitating the transportation of approximately 40% of Burkina Faso’s petroleum products, up from 15% two years ago, Minister for Energy and Green Transition, Dr John Abdulai Jinapor, has disclosed.

results.title: KGL Foundation screens over 200 people in Techiman for breast cancer and other conditions
results.content: More than 200 residents of Techiman have benefited from a free health screening exercise organised by the KGL Foundation as part of activities marking Breast Cancer Awareness Month. The outreach, organised in collaboration with Koranteng Memorial Clinic and AgricoHub, offered screening for breast cancer, blood pressure, Human Papillomavirus (HPV), hepatitis B and C, and eye conditions, among other services. Organisers said the initiative was intended to promote early detection and preventive healthcare while making screening services more accessible to residents.

results.title: Government develops roadmap to improve maternal healthcare and hospital bed management
results.content: The Deputy Minister for Health, Dr Grace Ayensu-Danquah, says the government is developing a roadmap to address challenges in maternal healthcare and improve the quality of care across all regions.

results.title: GES report identifies teacher divisions, student gangs as factors in Obuasi SHTS unrest
results.content: Ashanti Regional Directorate of the Ghana Education Service (GES) committee that investigated the August 2026 protest at Obuasi Senior High Technical School has found that factions among teachers and student gangs are undermining discipline, staff cohesion and the administration of the school.
